display_name: Mercedes-AMG F1 W17 V6 Turbo Hybrid (1.6L)

metadata.source: Mercedes-AMG F1 W17 (2016 F1 Season) - Public data approximations
metadata.notes: 1.6L V6 turbo hybrid (ICE ~500hp + ERS ~500hp). 90° V6 with 120° split-pin crank. Bore 80mm x stroke 53mm = 1600cc. Compression ~14:1. Redline 15,000 rpm (F1 limit). Turbocharged with MGU-H/MGU-K. F1 spec fuel ~RON 100. Fire angles for 90° V6 with 120° split-pin crank (uneven firing: 90°/150° intervals). Vehicle mass 733kg (car+driver minimum 2016). Drag area ~1.2 m² for F1 car. 8-speed sequential gearbox. Idle target 5000 rpm (F1 engines don't idle low). VE scale 1.15 for turbo charging efficiency.
